sources.title: The Clifford group, stabilizer states, and linear and quadratic operations over GF(2)
sources.locator: Abstract; Section I; Section II, Theorems 1-3 (composition and inverse formulas)
sources.exact_claim_read: Binary linear and quadratic data describe Clifford operations and their standard-basis coefficients.
sources.model_assumptions: Qubit Clifford operators; quadratic refinements retain more than their symplectic action.
sources.actionable_transfer: Compact individual letters, retaining phase data; an additive bank shear is not itself a Clifford unitary.

sources.title: Improved Simulation of Stabilizer Circuits
sources.locator: Abstract; Section I; Section VI, Theorem 8 and steps 1-6 of its proof
sources.exact_claim_read: An improved stabilizer simulator avoids Gaussian elimination and a canonical circuit uses O(n^2/log n) gates.
sources.model_assumptions: Stabilizer-state simulation; compact state output is not an arbitrary amplitude array.
sources.actionable_transfer: Use tableau screening, followed by exact phase-bearing coefficient replay.

sources.title: Hadamard-free circuits expose the structure of the Clifford group

sources.exact_claim_read: Cliffords have unique constrained Borel-Hadamard-permutation-Borel descriptions computable in polynomial time.
sources.model_assumptions: Overall phase is ignored in the counting convention; Hadamard-free maps are monomial.
sources.actionable_transfer: Canonicalize free words and neighbors, then restore the absolute phase before additions.

sources.title: Shorter stabilizer circuits via Bruhat decomposition and quantum circuit transformations

sources.actionable_transfer: Search Hadamard-free double cosets; test its rank coordinate independently.

sources.title: Optimal Hadamard gate count for Clifford+T synthesis of Pauli rotations sequences
sources.exact_claim_read: Minimal H count for the specified Pauli diagonalization network is rank([X;A]), with the defined commutativity matrix.
sources.model_assumptions: Fixed Pauli sequence; final-Clifford and internal-H objectives differ.
sources.actionable_transfer: Score individual-letter synthesis with this objective; retain a separate paid Gaussian invoice.

sources.title: The ZX-calculus is complete for stabilizer quantum mechanics

sources.exact_claim_read: Scaled rules and extra scalar machinery extend stabilizer ZX completeness to exact scalars and zero diagrams.
sources.model_assumptions: Scaled stabilizer semantics; scalar factors are part of equality.
sources.actionable_transfer: Reject projectively equal replacements inside an additive prefix sum.
